title: Mortgage Prepayment & Default Risk Modelling

blueprintSignals.name: Refinance incentive
blueprintSignals.definition: current coupon minus prevailing offer rate for the borrower's LTV and score band
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Market rate must be as at the month, not today

blueprintSignals.name: Loan seasoning curve
blueprintSignals.definition: piecewise hazard by months since origination
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Vintage and seasoning mix if not stratified

blueprintSignals.name: Current LTV with house price index
blueprintSignals.definition: balance divided by indexed property value using the local HPI
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: HPI release lags the decision date

blueprintSignals.name: Payment shock
blueprintSignals.definition: scheduled payment change at the next reset divided by current payment
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: The reset date must be known contractually, not learned from the outcome

engineFeatures.meaning: the cohort the subject joined, used for the time-based split

label: For "Mortgage Prepayment & Default Risk Modelling": Forecast monthly prepayment and default for each mortgage so pricing, hedging, provisioning and servicing capacity use the right cash flows. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Random split leaks vintages across train and test.
